mapper.update: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS bike_unified_acceptance CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COLUMN_DEFAULT FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='bike_unified_migration_test' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('bike_customer','bike_product_model','bike_warehouse','bike_warehouse_location','bike_production_sku','bike_vehicle','bike_production_vehicle') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

INSERT IGNORE INTO bike_vehicle(id,frame_sn,model_id,status,vehicle_qr_code,vehicle_qr_token,current_warehouse_id,current_location_id,stock_in_time) WITH RECURSIVE numbers(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM numbers WHERE n<100) SELECT 990000+n,CONCAT('UF-FRAME-',n),990001,2,CONCAT('UF-QR-',n),CONCAT('UF-TOKEN-',n),990001,990001,NOW(3) FROM numbers
INSERT IGNORE INTO bike_production_vehicle(vehicle_id,task_id,sku_id,batch_no) SELECT id,CONCAT('UF-TASK-',id),990001,'UF-ACCEPTANCE' FROM bike_vehicle WHERE id BETWEEN 990001 AND 990100
mapper.select: SELECT vehicle_qr_code FROM bike_vehicle WHERE model_id=990001 AND status=2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
